items.stem: What is a web of tiny linked units that learn patterns from examples?

options.A: A list of fixed if-then rules written by a person
options.B: A single giant formula that never changes
options.C: A neural network — many tiny units linked together

items.stem: What happens in the AI's practice phase, when it learns from examples?

options.A: A person types every correct answer by hand each time
options.B: Internal dials get tuned so common patterns fire more strongly
options.C: The AI copies one document and never changes again

items.stem: What does generative AI mainly do?

options.A: Builds new text, images, or sound that fits learned patterns
options.B: Only sorts old files into folders
options.C: Only checks spelling against a dictionary

items.stem: How does generative AI usually create a new sentence?

options.A: It opens a private database of true facts and copies one
options.B: It waits for a human to finish every word
options.C: It predicts the next small chunk of text that fits the pattern

items.stem: How is generative AI different from a calculator?

options.A: A calculator invents new math rules each day
options.B: A calculator follows fixed steps; generative AI builds from patterns
options.C: They work in exactly the same way

items.stem: Why can generative AI invent a beach photo that nobody took?

options.A: It recombines patterns it saw in many example images
options.B: It traveled to a real beach and took the shot
options.C: It always stores one perfect beach photo forever

items.stem: What are the "internal dials" tuned during practice?

options.A: The volume buttons on your phone
options.B: The Wi-Fi password the AI uses
options.C: Settings inside the system that shape which patterns fire

items.stem: A coworker says: "The AI must store every sentence it will ever write." What is better?

options.A: Yes — every future sentence is saved in advance
options.B: No — it builds each reply piece by piece from patterns
options.C: Only poems are stored; emails are written by hand

items.stem: You ask an AI for a short product slogan. What is it mainly doing?

options.A: Predicting likely words that fit slogans it has seen in practice
options.B: Calling your marketing team for the official line
options.C: Rolling a die and ignoring your request
